Entity.name: Transferable deposit
Entity.commentInRDBMS: A Transferable deposit is an Overnight deposit fulfilling the definition of Regulation (EU) 549/2013, 5.80: Definition: transferable deposits are deposits exchangeable for currency on demand, at par, and which are directly usable for making payments by cheque, draft, giro order, direct debit/credit, or other direct payment facilities, without penalty or restriction.

Attribute.name: Overdraft indicator
Attribute.comment:
Overdraft indicator indicates whether the Transferable deposit is in an overdraft situation or not.
Overdraft is a debit balance on a current account. As defined in point 2(1)(c) of the Table in Part 2 of Annex II to Regulation (EU) No 2021/379 (BSI)
